data.description:
## Description

**What failed:** harvest-worktree.sh (line 229-237) unconditionally requires review-status in the worktree artifacts dir, but per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 2 explicitly says to skip the review pipeline (including record-review.sh) in ci-pr mode.

**Root cause:** Design gap between the harvest gate and the ci-pr skip:
- commit-workflow-validation.md Step 6 (ci-pr mode) emits reviewer-record.skipped but does NOT write review-status
- harvest-worktree.sh checks for review-status and has no .skipped fallback

**Workaround:** Direct git merge into the story branch bypassing harvest-worktree.sh (review gate passes in ci-pr mode without review-status, so the merge commit succeeds).

**Fix:** harvest-worktree.sh should check for reviewer-record.skipped (or check dso.workflow=ci-pr) and bypass the review-status gate when ci-pr mode is active, just as the pre-commit review gate does.

**Observed at:** Sprint 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f, task 6797-cdba-d598-4992 harvest attempt.
data.title: [ci-pr-harvest-gap]: harvest-worktree.sh requires review-status but ci-pr mode skips record-review.sh
